class.name: NetwSpawnPark
class.brief_description: The SPAWN frames waiting for something this peer does not have yet.
class.description: One book rather than two, because a parked route and the frame it parked are one fact. Kept apart, a caller can drop the flag and leave the payload, and the next arrival applies a spawn nothing is waiting for. What a row waits ON decides who retries it. A [constant WAIT_ROUTE] row is retried by its route going live and is bounded by that waiter, so it carries no deadline of its own. A [constant WAIT_SCENE] row has no route to wait on, so any scene arrival retries it and a wall deadline is what stops it waiting forever. [codeblock] park(route, payload, wait, deadline) answers false for a second arrival take(route) the retry's one answer cancel(route) the despawn's, with net result zero [/codeblock]

method.name: anchor_parks
method.description: Whether a frame naming an anchor whose route is in [param state] parks rather than resolving or dropping. It parks on [constant NetwLivenessCore.STATE_UNKNOWN], which means the frame arrived before the route it depends on, and on [constant NetwLivenessCore.STATE_DEAD], which means an interest re-admission whose reviving spawn is still in flight on the same reliable ordered channel. It does NOT park on [constant NetwLivenessCore.STATE_LINGERING], because a lingering route is still resolvable and waiting for it would defer a frame that can be applied now.

method.name: cancel
method.description: Drops a park without applying it, answering whether there was one. This is what a despawn arriving mid-park does, and its net result is zero.

method.name: clear
method.description: Forgets every park, which is what a session end means for all of them.

method.name: has
method.description: Whether a frame is parked for [param route].

method.name: is_expired
method.description: Whether [param route]'s wall deadline has passed. A [constant WAIT_ROUTE] row has none, so it never expires here: the waiter that bounds it says when it gives up.

method.name: park
method.description: Parks the frame that would spawn [param route], answering whether it is new. A route already parked keeps the frame it parked with, because the second frame is the same spawn arriving twice.

method.name: size
method.description: Frames parked, on either kind of wait.

method.name: take
method.description: The frame parked for [param route], forgetting the row in the same act. A route nothing parked answers an empty run, which is also what a cancelled park answers, so a retry that lost its race applies nothing.

method.name: waiting_on
method.description: Every route parked on [param wait], in no particular order.

constants.constant: The frame waits for a route it depends on to go live, and that waiter bounds it.
The frame waits for the scene subtree holding a consumed spawner, retried by any scene arrival and bounded by its own deadline.
